subject.title: fix(doctor): bound AGENTS.md and root-memory file reads

question: Should the assigned root-memory owner accept the fixed 1 MiB `AGENTS.md` and 8 MiB root-memory ceilings as the intended no-mutation doctor policy for existing oversized workspaces?
rationale: The exact ceilings are a compatibility policy choice: they trade automatic migration of very large existing journals for bounded memory use and manual recovery, which code review cannot calibrate from source alone.

options.title: Accept bounded no-mutation policy
options.body: Keep the fixed ceilings and merge after final-head proof shows that a race which invalidates the archived legacy read leaves the user with a recoverable legacy file.

options.title: Revise the migration policy
options.body: Change the limits or recovery behavior only if maintainers want large existing root-memory journals to remain eligible for automatic consolidation.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded no-mutation policy
recommendation.body: Keep the fixed ceilings and merge after final-head proof shows that a race which invalidates the archived legacy read leaves the user with a recoverable legacy file.

likelyOwner.reason: The current head’s race-preservation commit and assignment connect this decision to the active root-memory implementation path.
